data.action: 伫立于高空平台边缘俯瞰下方红色海洋
data.camera: medium shot, standing on a high platform overlooking the crimson LCL lake
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 最终教条的神圣肃穆】深邃浩瀚的地底最终教条区，庞大无垠的LCL红海散发着神圣而压抑的光晕。绫波丽身着白色的战斗服独立于钢铁升降梯前端，凝视着沉眠于十字架上的神之具现，眼底涌动着超越人类理解的崇高宿命——「这就是最初与最终的源头……一切生命归于一体的时刻，终将到来。」
data.lighting: 地下红海暗红辉光与高空探照冷光交错
data.location: NERV 最终教条区 LCL 巨大湖泊
data.promptProse: Rei stands alone at the front of the steel platform above Terminal Dogma's crimson LCL lake, wearing her white plugsuit and red neural-interface clips. She looks toward the immense sleeping figure suspended on its cross. The medium view carries the platform edge toward the distant body. Dark red lake glow rises onto her suit's lower panels, while a cold overhead searchlight outlines her head and the near platform rail.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 最终教条的神圣肃穆
